title: PMC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 07 Senior Public Health Specialist, Veterinary Officer, Technical Assistant and Other Posts
description: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 07  Senior Public Health Specialists, Veterinary Officers, Technical Assistants, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech, B.Sc, M.Sc, BDS, BUMS, BHMS, BAMS, DMLT, B.V.Sc and MBBS can grab this chance and apply for the PMC Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply...
